title: Jobs list: weekly view with navigation
tech: Node.js, TypeScript, Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma 6, Zod, Vitest, React 18, Vite, CSS Modules, Axios
keyConstraints: TypeScript strict mode, Zod validation server-side, .nullish() not .optional().nullable(), Prisma selects must include all returned fields (jobInclude is source of truth), no UI component libraries, CSS Modules only
description: Add a weekly view mode to JobsPage. Users can toggle between the existing list view and a new weekly view. The weekly view shows jobs grouped by weekday columns (Mon–Sun). Navigation: ← / → buttons to move one week at a time, plus a date-picker input to jump to any week. The active week label shows Finnish-style date range (e.g. '16.6. – 22.6.2026'). The week starts on Monday.
acceptanceCriteria: A view-toggle control in the filter bar lets users switch between 'List' and 'Week' modes; selection persists within the session
In Week view, job cards are displayed in seven day-columns (Ma–Su) headed with weekday name and date (e.g. 'Ma 16.6.')
Week navigation ← and → buttons shift the displayed week by one; the week label between them shows the range in Finnish format 'D.M. – D.M.YYYY'
A date-picker input lets the user jump directly to any week; selecting a date snaps to that date's Monday
The weekly view fetches jobs with scheduledFrom / scheduledTo query params scoped to the selected week; existing status filter still applies
npx tsc --noEmit passes with no errors
implementationNotes: Reuse week navigation pattern from DispatcherBoard schedule view (startOfWeek, addWeeks, subWeeks, addDays from date-fns; FI_WEEKDAYS array)
Backend already supports scheduledFrom/scheduledTo params (used by MyJobsPage) — no backend changes needed
List view and its pagination remain unchanged
No new dependencies — date-fns is already installed
Do not rewrite working code — only add what is missing
CSS Modules only — no inline styles
Use axiosInstance from api/axios.ts, not apiService
securityConsiderations: None beyond existing — no new endpoints, no new write paths.
